summary: Iteration 10 - Full backend + frontend E2E testing of (a) Quote Approval → Invoice flow and (b) Contracts & E-Signatures. Backend: 15/16 tests pass (1 tenant-isolation initially skipped due to wrong register payload, fixed and now passes → effectively 16/16 with one edge-case bug: converting an already-converted quote returns 400 instead of the required 409). Frontend E2E: complete flows work — Contracts nav link → template create → contract create → send (public URL copied to clipboard + toast) → public sign page (unauthenticated) → typed signature → row status flips to 'signed'. Quotes: /finance → Quotes tab → new-quote → share (toast + copy-quote appears + status='sent') → public accept page (unauthenticated) → 'Quote accepted' → convert-quote → toast 'Invoice created from quote' + quote status='converted' + new invoice INV-00013 appears in Invoices tab.

minor.issue: Converting an already-converted quote returns 400 'Only accepted quotes can be converted' instead of the required 409. Order of guards in convert_quote_to_invoice: the status check runs before the converted_invoice_id check, so once status flips to 'converted' the 409 branch is unreachable. Fix: swap the two if-blocks, or add 'converted' to a dedicated 409 branch first.
No single-quote GET endpoint exists (only list/patch/delete). Invoices have GET single. Inconsistency — worth adding for UI parity.

issues: Line-item inputs (Description / qty / unit price / tax_rate) have NO data-testid attributes — makes automated testing fragile. Only quote-client-input and quote-save-btn are testable.
Uses browser-native date picker (<input type='date'>) for Issue date instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere.
Invoices/Quotes/Expenses tabs on /finance have no data-testid (only 'tab-quotes' is present; 'tab-invoices' and 'tab-expenses' are missing).
Currency defaults to 'EUR' but backend list uses '$' for other invoices — inconsistent display in Invoices tab (INV-00013 shows €1,000.00, older TEST_pdf ones show $10.00).
Tabs (All/Signed/Pending) are clickable but have no individual data-testid (only contracts-tabs container). Minor.

action_items: Fix convert-twice returning 400 instead of 409: reorder guards in /app/backend/app/modules/quote_flow/routes.py::convert_quote_to_invoice (check converted_invoice_id / status=='converted' BEFORE the 'must be accepted' check).
Add data-testid attributes to line-item inputs in the QuoteForm modal (description, qty, unit_price, tax_rate, add-row, remove-row).
Add data-testid='tab-invoices' and 'tab-expenses' on Finance tabs for symmetry with tab-quotes.
Consider adding GET /api/v1/quotes/{qid} for parity with invoices.
critical_code_review_comments: quote_flow/routes.py convert_quote_to_invoice: guard-order bug (see above). Also the response has no explicit status_code so it returns default 200 — consider 201 since a new resource is created.
contracts/routes.py _is_expired: string comparison of ISO date works because YYYY-MM-DD sorts lexicographically. Fine but fragile — comment it or parse to date().

quote_flow/routes.py share_quote regenerates status='sent' on every share call — if quote was already accepted/converted, calling /share again would silently regress status. Consider guarding against non-draft/non-sent statuses.
quote share_token has no expiry — anyone with the URL can accept the quote forever. Consider optional expires_at on quote share.
contracts routes.py public_sign stores IP but does not hash — GDPR consideration (minor).

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 first run; tenant-isolation now passing on fix → effectively 15/16 with 1 documented convert-twice-409 bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (contract e-sign end-to-end, quote share/accept/convert end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 contracts (E2E Contract + TEST_MSA — TEST_MSA signed by E2E Signer), 1 template (E2E TPL), 1 quote (QUO-00001 converted to INV-00013). Left in DB under tenant owner@nedtech.media for regression traceability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + Frontend both validated for iter 10 quote/contract flows. Only one bug remains: POST /quotes/{qid}/convert returns 400 instead of 409 on a second convert. Everything else — public unauthenticated pages, tenant isolation, PDF streaming, expired contract 410, sign-without-consent 400, second-decision 409 — works. Public URLs are absolute (FRONTEND_URL in backend .env). React /public/quote/:token and /public/contract/:token render fine without auth cookies.
rca_of_the_issue: convert_quote_to_invoice checks 'status not in (accepted,)' FIRST → returns 400 for any non-accepted status including 'converted'. It then checks converted_invoice_id → but that 409 branch is unreachable. Reproduction: create quote → accept → convert (→200) → convert again (→400 instead of 409). Fix: move the converted_invoice_id / status=='converted' check BEFORE the accepted-status check, or return 409 when status == 'converted'.
